classified_spans.text:
Here is the analysis of all 35 open issues on tutors-sdk/tutors, organized by category.

---

## BUGS (8 issues)

**#982 - Course card visibility** (May 2025, no labels) -- Cards not visible on Chrome/Mac but visible on tablet for same course. No PR addresses it. **Priority: High** -- affects content visibility.

**#829 - Course temporarily returns 404/502** (Oct 2024, no labels) -- Stale courses return 502 on first load after extended idle; refresh fixes it. 2 comments (may relate to deployment invalidation). No PR addresses it. **Priority: High** -- user-facing error.

**#779 - Themes don't work on homepage** (Jun 2024, no labels) -- Theme switcher has no effect on tutors.dev homepage. 3 comments with debugging by @lgriffin identifying `storeTheme` hardcoding. No PR addresses it. **Priority: Medium**.

**#780 - Images only work in lightmode or darkmode** (Jun 2024, no labels) -- Some images illegible when mode changes. 1 comment with a proposed CSS approach. No PR addresses it. **Priority: Medium**.

**#692 - Redirect on Sign in unreliable** (Jan 2024, no labels) -- Auth redirect sends users to tutors.dev instead of the course that prompted sign-in. No PR. **Priority: High** -- breaks auth flow.

**#691 - Course Whitelist inoperable** (Jan 2024, no labels) -- Enrolment-based access control is broken. No PR. **Priority: High** -- security feature non-functional.

**#1035 - Ghost Sessions in presence** (Jan 2026, no labels) -- Presence records persist after browser close, inflating online counts. Detailed fix proposed. PR #1065 partially addresses error handling but not this specific issue. **Priority: Medium**.

**#938 - Broken link to tutors-holopin** (Jan 2025, no labels) -- README contains a dead image link. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

---

## FEATURE REQUESTS (10 issues)

**#932 - GenAI augmentation (eli5 tutors)** (Jan 2025) -- AI-powered explanations, web search, and content-improvement suggestions. Ambitious scope. No PR. **Priority: Medium** -- high value but large effort.

**#683 - Assignment Submission Service** (Jan 2024) -- Moodle-like submissions with rubrics and feedback. Assigned to @ianbl8 as a separate repo. No PR. **Priority: Medium**.

**#685 - Text Search PDF content** (Jan 2024) -- Extend search to PDF/talk content via JSON extraction. 3 comments with a detailed roadmap from @edeleastar. No PR. **Priority: Medium**.

**#684 - Search Text Summaries** (Jan 2024) -- Extend search to card summaries. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#678 - Bookmarking learning objects** (Jan 2024) -- Let students bookmark labs/topics/videos. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#675 - LabChat** (Jan 2024) -- Ephemeral IRC-style chat sidebar during labs via PartyKit. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#674 - Internationalisation** (Jan 2024) -- i18n strategy using sveltekit-i18n. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#673 - Lab Full Screen Mode** (Jan 2024) -- Hide chrome for focused lab work. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#671 - Group Tutors Live Cards** (Jan 2024) -- Group presence cards by course/LO. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#667 - Presence Status strings** (Jan 2024) -- Custom status like "Stuck!" on live cards. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

---

## ENHANCEMENTS (5 issues)

**#1034 - Centralize route logic** (Jan 2026) -- Replace hardcoded string interpolation routes with a `route-utils.ts`. No PR. **Priority: Medium** -- reduces fragility.

**#1033 - Consolidate Supabase Auth init** (Jan 2026) -- Single auth subscription point to prevent race conditions / UI flicker. No PR. **Priority: Medium**.

**#1032 - Unified Lo type safety** (Jan 2026) -- Base interface for all Learning Objects plus type guards. No PR. **Priority: Medium** -- improves maintainability.

**#831 - Questionnaires** (Oct 2024) -- Documents that `<details>` tag works for self-assessment quizzes. More documentation than enhancement. **Priority: Low**.

**#677 - Redesign Dashboard** (Jan 2024) -- Card-based layout for recently accessed courses. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

---

## TECH DEBT / INFRA (12 issues)

**#680 - Enable SSR** (Jan 2024) -- SSR disabled globally due to CSR-only markdown plugins. PR #987 directly addresses this. **Priority: High** -- affects performance and SEO.

**#832 - Skeleton 3 Upgrade** (Oct 2024) -- UI framework upgrade. No PR. **Priority: High** -- framework debt.

**#679 - Replace Supabase Auth** (Jan 2024) -- Abstract auth provider (Lucia/Auth.js). No PR. **Priority: Medium**.

**#682 - Security Audit for .env / API keys** (Jan 2024) -- Review key exposure. PR #1065 adds security headers but does not address env management. **Priority: Medium**.

**#702 - Version Management** (Feb 2024) -- Enforce semver and sync CLI/reader versions. 2 comments with strategy. No PR. **Priority: Medium**.

**#689 - Encrypt tutors.json** (Jan 2024) -- Encrypt/compress course JSON. 1 comment with PR-in-progress. **Priority: Low**.

**#700 - netlify.toml research** (Feb 2024) -- Add build config file. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#698 - Support Vercel + GH Pages** (Feb 2024) -- Reduce Netlify dependency. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#687 - Upgrade static HTML generator** (Jan 2024) -- Match reader style. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#836 - Factor Live into separate app** (Oct 2024) -- Architectural separation. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#815/814 - Factor out Analytics** (Oct 2024) -- Separate analytics UX and repackage as serverless. No PR. **Priority: Low**.

**#672 - Accessibility Audit** (Jan 2024) -- Ongoing; initial violations fixed in PR #699 but recommendations remain. **Priority: Medium**.

Remaining infra: #835 (rework getting started), #834 (review sample courses), #833 (icon sets), #676 (illustrated reference manual) -- all low priority docs/content tasks from Oct 2024/Jan 2024.

---

## STALE ISSUES (older than 6 months, no recent activity)

All 27 issues from 2024 (#667-#836) qualify as stale. The most notable are the 4 open bugs (#779, #780, #691, #692) and the SSR issue (#680) which has a corresponding PR. The Jan 2025 issues (#932, #938) are also stale.

---

## PR-TO-ISSUE MAPPING

| PR | Addresses Issues |
|----|-----------------|
| #987 (SSR Fix) | #680 (SSR) directly |
| #1062 (Testing) | No specific issue; general tech debt |
| #1063 (Mermaid/Marp) | No issue filed |
| #1064 (Jupyter Notebook) | No issue filed |
| #1065 (Critical fixes) | Partially #682 (security); tangentially #1035 |
| #1066 (Prettier) | No issue; general hygiene |
| #1043 (Arch flow) | No clear match |

---

## KEY PATTERNS

1. **January 2024 bulk filing**: 20 issues filed by @edeleastar in one sprint -- a roadmap dump. Most remain untouched. Consider triaging and closing aspirational ones.

2. **January 2026 cluster by @codeCraft-Ritik**: Issues #1032-1035 are well-structured with code fixes included. These are ready to convert into PRs.

3. **Auth/security cluster**: Issues #679, #682, #691, #692, #1033 all touch authentication and security -- worth addressing together.

4. **Search cluster**: #684 and #685 form a natural pair for extending search.

5. **Architecture separation cluster**: #814, #815, #836 all propose factoring out subsystems -- long-term architectural vision.

6. **No labels on any issue** -- the repo does not use GitHub labels, making triage harder.

1. `gh issue list --repo tutors-sdk/tutors --state open --limit 100 --json number,title,labels,createdAt,author,comments,body`

For your report, organize the issues into:
- **Bugs** — reported defects
- **Feature requests** — new functionality
- **Enhancements** — improvements to existing features
- **Tech debt / infra** — build, CI, testing, docs
- **Stale** — issues older than 6 months with no recent activity

For each issue, note:
- Number, title, age, labels
- Brief summary of what it asks for
- Whether any of the 7 open PRs (#987, #1043, #1062, #1063, #1064, #1065, #1066) address it
- Priority assessment (critical/high/medium/low) based on impact

Also flag any patterns — e.g. clusters of related issues, repeatedly reported problems, issues that could be addressed together.

Report in under 800 words, structured by category.
